blurb: Guests fish for muskies on Lake St. Clair using casting, jigging, or trolling techniques. The captains have extensive knowledge of the lake and fishery and aim to provide a safe, educational, and enjoyable trip. The business has a strong tournament record and holds the Lake St. Clair muskie length record.
